composio.note: Composio offers a managed Harvest OAuth app, suitable for prototypes. For production, create an auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Not for a prototype, because Composio manages a Harvest OAuth app. For production, use your own so users see your app name, you get a dedicated quota, and you control scopes.
reasons: Consent screen shows your brand, not Composio's
Dedicated quota instead of quota shared across all Composio users
Enterprise customers who require your branding end to end
Composio's default scopes may not cover what you need

scenarios.label: Public integration for Harvest time tracking
scenarios.when_this_applies: Your agent connects many customers' Harvest accounts through one OAuth2 app you register in Harvest ID.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured

waiting.basis: No review or approval step is described in the Harvest docs found (c1, c2); not confirmed as absent.

scenarios.approval: No provider review is described in the Harvest docs; the path is inferred from the registration docs. Review criteria for public apps were not found.

prerequisites.title: Harvest administrator login
prerequisites.detail: Registering an OAuth app requires being logged in as an Administrator on the Harvest account (per the older v1 page). Apps are created in the Developers section of Harvest ID.

prerequisites.title: Decide products and account scope
prerequisites.detail: Choose Harvest, Forecast or both, and whether the app supports multiple accounts. The docs advise the minimal scope.

steps.title: Get the redirect URI from Composio
steps.detail: Open the Composio dashboard for the Harvest toolkit and copy the redirect URI to use as the app's Redirect URL. Pick the minimal products scope.
steps.done_when: Redirect URI copied and products choice drafted.

steps.title: Register the OAuth2 app in Harvest ID
steps.detail: As an Administrator, create the app in the Developers section of Harvest ID. Enter name, Redirect URL, multi-account setting and products.
steps.done_when: Harvest shows the client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create the Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API using your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: Auth config exists for the Harvest toolkit.

steps.title: Test with a second Harvest account
steps.detail: Connect a Harvest account other than your own, confirm the consent screen shows your app name, and check that token refresh works.
steps.done_when: Connected account can call the API and refresh its token.

traps.title: Research mixed in Greenhouse's Harvest API
traps.detail: Much of the evidence gathered covers Greenhouse's Harvest API, a different product that needs a signed partner agreement and at least one mutual customer. It does not apply to Harvest time tracking at getharvest.com.

traps.title: Token lifetimes are inconsistent across docs
traps.detail: The deprecated v1 page says tokens last 18 hours, while the current v2 example shows 1209600 seconds. Build refresh logic from the v2 docs and test it.

traps.title: Redirect URL must match
traps.detail: A redirect_uri passed at authorization must start with the Redirect URL registered with the app. Use the exact URI from the Composio dashboard.

traps.title: Managed app shows Composio's name
traps.detail: With the managed app users see Composio's name on consent and share quota with all Composio users. That is fine for prototypes only.

open_questions: Does Harvest review or restrict public OAuth2 apps, or cap users before approval? Ask Harvest support or check the Developers section in Harvest ID.
Do customers' account admins need to approve the app? Not found; test with a customer-owned account.
What are the current access and refresh token lifetimes? Test a real token response.
Not found: what each review or verification checks and what the developer must submit. Checked getharvest.com, github.com.
